name: pr-dash
description: Claude Code mod that shows a pull request's CI checks and AI review result in a pane, status line and toasts; actions only hand prompts to Claude.

interface.shortDescription: PR checks and AI review status.
interface.longDescription: Reports a pull request's CI checks and AI review result as text with the read-only pr-status skill. The Claude Code pane, status line and toasts are a Claude-only mod and are not part of the Codex package.
defaultPrompt: Show this branch's PR checks and AI review status.
